final: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate
